evidence.claim: Integrates the verified CNF variable-renaming lemma into the canonical research tree. For every renaming, truth assignment and CNF formula, evaluation commutes with renaming. This is textbook mathematics, not a new discovery. The proof expression already appears as a development fixture; this submission adds the first accepted formal component through the actual protocol. Consider only modest infrastructure integration credit, or reject if this is insufficient.
